description: Same-device FCM signup OTP without a new .aab: thread an optional deviceToken through POST /api/otp/send -> deliverSignupOtp -> the FCM attempt so the signup OTP can be delivered to the CURRENT device's own (guest) FCM token, which the shipped app already registers. Keep email-only and mobile-only (no deviceToken) behavior byte-identical, keep WhatsApp-before-FCM order and the admin otp_channels policy semantics unchanged, and keep the never-throws graceful-fallback contract (the resolver still returns fallbackOtp when nothing delivers so signup never breaks). Also VERIFY (no change expected) the already-complete WhatsApp OTP wiring and the admin OTP-channel + WhatsApp API config UI. Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: In api-node/src/routes/otp.ts add `deviceToken: z.string().min(1).max(4096).optional()` to sendSchema (alongside email/mobile; the email-or-mobile refine is unchanged) and pass it as `deliverSignupOtp({ email, mobile, deviceToken })`.

In api-node/src/services/otpDelivery.ts add `deviceToken?: string` to DeliverSignupOtpInput. In the MOBILE path, build the FCM candidate token list as the union of the provided deviceToken (only when a non-empty trimmed string) and tokensForUser(user?.id) where the user row is looked up once by mobile (tolerate no row via .catch(()=>null)), de-duplicated with a Set and filtered for truthy. Refactor tryFcm to take that token array (or inline the token build + sendToTokens call) and keep the send payload { title: '\ud83d\udd10 4A Store verification code', body: `Your 4A Store signup code is ${otp}. It expires in 10 minutes.`, data: { type: 'signup_otp' } }; treat sent>0 as delivered; any throw => not delivered.

Keep readOtpChannelPolicy + resolveMobileChannelOrder exactly as-is so only the WHICH-tokens behavior of the FCM attempt changes, not the channel order/policy. Preserve the final fallback return (delivered:false, fallbackOtp:otp) when no channel delivers.

Add a concise code comment in otpDelivery.ts near the FCM attempt stating same-device push is weak verification (code arrives on the same device), it is a convenience channel gated by the admin otp_channels policy, and the fallback still applies when no token delivers; do NOT remove or weaken the fallback.

In web/src/pages/Login.tsx sendOtp(): for the MOBILE branch (!emailFilled && mobileValid) include `deviceToken` in the /otp/send body ONLY if a device push token is readily available client-side; in a plain browser none exists today so omit it. Never block or delay the request on token availability. Add a brief comment that native same-device FCM delivery would need a future app change to expose the WebView's FCM token, and that the guest-token path + backend fallback cover the requirement now. Do NOT invent a window bridge the app does not have.

VERIFY ONLY (fix minimally only if a real gap is found, else record 'verified complete'): api-node/src/services/otpDelivery.ts tryWhatsApp passes the OTP as body {{1}} via buildImageTextComponents({ bodyParams:[otp] }) and returns false when WHATSAPP_OTP_TEMPLATE is empty; api-node/src/services/whatsappCloud.ts reads creds only from the admin-only settings.whatsapp_api blob and never hardcodes a token; api-node/src/routes/admin.ts GET/POST /settings persist+return whatsappApi and otpChannels while public GET /api/settings never exposes them; web/src/pages/admin/marketing/AutoSendComingSoon.tsx renders both the WhatsApp API config form and the OTP-channel selector (OtpChannelCard) and saves via saveAdminSettings.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` in api-node (tsc) passes and `npm test` in api-node passes (95+ tests, including otpChannelPolicy).
`npm run build` in web passes (tsc -b && vite build).
POST /api/otp/send accepts an optional deviceToken; an email-only or mobile-only request with NO deviceToken produces exactly the same stored OTP key + response shape as before (reasoned from code).

In the mobile path the FCM attempt considers [deviceToken] UNION tokensForUser(user?.id) de-duplicated, respects the otp_channels policy order, and the resolver still returns fallbackOtp when nothing delivers (signup never breaks).
Admin OTP-channel selector (FCM/WhatsApp/Both) and the WhatsApp API config form are present and wired admin-only; otp_channels/whatsapp_api are never on the public settings payload.
verification: cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\fcm-signup-and-order-weight\4astore-v2\api-node && npm run build && npm test

If api-node tsc reports 'Untyped function calls may not accept type arguments' on prisma.$queryRawUnsafe, re-copy node_modules/.prisma/client from the sibling main repo (see context.json environment_constraints) and rebuild; do NOT run prisma generate.
findings: IMPLEMENTED. deviceToken field: name is `deviceToken`, type optional string, zod `z.string().min(1).max(4096).optional()` on POST /api/otp/send sendSchema (alongside email/mobile; email-or-mobile refine unchanged). It flows otp.ts -> deliverSignupOtp({ email, mobile, deviceToken }) -> DeliverSignupOtpInput.deviceToken?: string. In the MOBILE path the FCM candidate list is built ONCE as `[...new Set([input.deviceToken?.trim()||'', ...tokensForUser(user?.id)].filter(Boolean))]` where the user row is looked up once by mobile with .catch(()=>null); tryFcm was refactored to take `tokens: string[]` (returns false on empty list) and keeps the exact send payload { title:'🔐 4A Store verification code', body:`Your 4A Store signup code is ${otp}. It expires in 10 minutes.`, data:{ type:'signup_otp' } }, sent>0 => delivered. Channel order/policy (readOtpChannelPolicy + resolveMobileChannelOrder, WhatsApp-before-FCM) is UNCHANGED; the final never-throws fallback (delivered:false, fallbackOtp:otp) is intact. EMAIL-only and MOBILE-only (no deviceToken) paths are byte-identical: same email_otps key ('email' lowercased or 'mobile:<mobile>'), same response shape devOtp. Added the weak-verification code comment near tryFcm. WEB: Login.tsx sendOtp() mobile branch still sends { mobile } only (no deviceToken) because a plain browser exposes no FCM token; added a comment that native same-device FCM would need a future app change to surface the WebView token and that the guest-token path + backend fallback cover it now — NO window bridge invented. WHATSAPP/ADMIN VERIFICATION = verified complete, NO gap found: tryWhatsApp passes OTP as buildImageTextComponents({ bodyParams:[otp] }) and returns false when WHATSAPP_OTP_TEMPLATE empty; whatsappCloud.ts reads creds only from settings.whatsapp_api (no hardcoded token); admin.ts GET/POST /settings persist+return whatsappApi+otpChannels behind requireAuth+requireStaff('settings'); public GET /api/settings lives in routes/catalog.ts and returns an explicit subset that NEVER includes whatsapp_api/otp_channels; AutoSendComingSoon.tsx renders both the WhatsApp API config form and OtpChannelCard (FCM/WhatsApp/Both) saving via saveAdminSettings. BUILD/TEST: api-node `npm run build` OK + `npm test` 95/95 pass; web `npm run build` OK (sitemap 202 URLs, vite built). prisma generate was NOT needed (no 'Untyped function calls' error this run). Live FCM/WhatsApp delivery not verifiable here — reasoned through.
